mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (measured as the 3-month change) is associated with positive 20-day S&P 500 returns, so the signal is always active and predicts positive returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods with negative FEDFUNDS 3-month change are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPI) exceeds 250 (1982-1984=100), it signals high inflation, which leads to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns as the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 250), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals a demand shock that leads to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as the Federal Reserve is expected to ease policy in response to weakening demand.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in < 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market with unemployment rate below 4.0% and strong job growth (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly), the S&P 500 is expected to produce negative 60-day returns as the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten policy to prevent inflation.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in < 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (2017=100), it signals a supply shock that leads to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns as the economy enters a recession.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 60% of triggered instances (INDPRO < 100), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real retail sales (RSAFS) is associated with positive 20-day S&P 500 returns, so the signal is always active and predicts positive returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods with rising RSAFS are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a monetary policy response to a weakening economy, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
regime_hint: monetary easing in response to supply shock
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in < 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle demand expansion (as indicated by HOUST above 1200 and GDP growth above 2% annually), the S&P 500 is expected to produce negative 60-day returns due to overheating and potential policy tightening.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in < 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
